policy: Preserve historical unresolved status; no contract/schema changes.
Historical chunk numbers belong only to the old 483-chunk segmentation.
Do not transplant these numbers into new segmentation or treat them as a complete list of new issues.
S1/S2 cleaning can proceed independently; do not pre-approve semantic annotations.
At S5/S6 reidentify affected source passages from exact available historical evidence, quarantine unsupported alternatives/relationships without inventing spans or deleting source.
The entire source cannot pass S5/S6 while its new unresolved blockers remain.
